test_failure_analysis.analysis: The failure pattern points to a compiler scoping/lowering bug triggered by nested item definitions inside an `async fn`. The source explicitly declares `impl<'a> Foo<'a>` at module scope, so lifetime `'a` is syntactically and semantically in scope for the outer impl. However, rustc reports E0261 on that very `impl<'a> Foo<'a>` and suggests introducing `'a` inside the nested `impl Bar` or `bar`, which indicates the compiler is incorrectly associating the undeclared lifetime with the nested async/local-item context rather than the outer impl header. The reproducer combines: (1) an inherent impl with a lifetime parameter, (2) an `async fn` requiring desugaring into an opaque future/generator, (3) a local struct and local inherent impl inside that async body, and (4) another nested async fn. The common theme is incorrect handling of generic parameter scopes across nested owners introduced during async lowering or item collection. Most likely, when rustc lowers or resolves the nested local impl/async items, it leaks or misapplies the outer generic context, causing lifetime resolution for the outer impl or nested generated items to consult the wrong binder/owner and conclude that `'a` is undeclared.

Counts elided lifetime occurrences encountered during traversal. It does not call other methods in this methods list.

Resolves a batch of elided lifetime references by walking enclosing scopes, synthesizing fresh anonymous late-bound regions when allowed, recording successful resolutions, and otherwise reporting missing or ambiguous lifetime errors. This method explicitly calls `impl RegionExt for Region::late_anon`.

Resolves an omitted object lifetime by searching outward for the nearest object-lifetime-default scope, adjusting for crossed binders, and defaulting to `'static` when appropriate. It calls `insert_lifetime` to record the chosen region.

Collects the generic lifetime parameters, validates their names, reports duplicate lifetime-parameter definitions in the same parameter list, and checks each lifetime parameter against outer scopes for shadowing. It explicitly calls `check_lifetime_param_for_shadowing` for each collected lifetime parameter.

Walks outward through the surrounding lifetime scopes to detect whether a newly declared lifetime parameter shadows an existing label or lifetime from an enclosing scope, and emits a shadowing diagnostic when it finds a conflict. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Determines whether lifetime-use tracking should be enabled in the current context by scanning enclosing scopes and returning the policy implied by item binders, bodies, or elision behavior. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Records the resolved `Region` for a lifetime HIR node in the temporary lifetime-definition map.
Removes a previously inserted lifetime resolution after an error and asserts that the removed region matches the expected bad definition.

Computes which function generic lifetimes are late-bound by collecting lifetimes constrained by input types, lifetimes appearing in the return type, and lifetimes used in where-clauses, then records the late-bound ones into the named-region map while traversing nested HIR as needed. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Collects only lifetimes that constrain an input type, skipping associated type projections and otherwise descending into the relevant final path segment or recursively walking the type. It calls `visit_path_segment` for plain resolved paths and `walk_ty` for other type forms.
Collects parameter lifetime definitions seen in constrained positions by inserting each named lifetime parameter into the collector set.
Collects every named lifetime parameter occurrence by inserting each parameter lifetime into the collector set.

Collects lifetime generic parameters, detects whether both explicit and in-band lifetime definitions are present, and emits E0688 when they are mixed. It calls itself indirectly through iterator processing only in the provided call list as `iter`, `filter_map`, `collect`, and `find`, then uses `span_label` and `emit` on the constructed diagnostic to report both spans.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_resolve/src/late.rs::impl: Returns a fixed human-readable description string for each `PatternSource` variant; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Constructs a new `Rib` with default-initialized bindings and the provided `RibKind`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Maps each `PathSource` to the namespace late resolution should search, using the type namespace for type/trait/struct contexts, the value namespace for expression/pattern/tuple-struct/delegation contexts, and preserving the namespace stored in `TraitItem`; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Indicates whether unresolved handling for this path source should be deferred to type checking, returning `true` for most type/value path contexts and `false` for trait, trait-item, and delegation contexts; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Produces the user-facing description of what kind of entity a path is expected to resolve to, with extra inspection for call expressions to distinguish values, functions, tuple structs/variants, and external crates; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Checks whether the path source is specifically an expression used as a call target; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.

Selects the appropriate resolution error code for this path context, distinguishing between missing names and names that resolved to an unexpected kind; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Skips late resolution for attributes so attribute-contained expressions are not treated as executable code; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Updates per-item diagnostic context, temporarily forces item-level error reporting, and resolves the item inside an item lifetime rib. Calls `with_lifetime_rib` and, inside it, `resolve_item`.
Delegates match-arm late resolution to `resolve_arm`.
Delegates block late resolution to `resolve_block`.
Resolves an anonymous const under nested anon-const and elided-static lifetime ribs, while excluding repeat-expression handling here. Calls `with_lifetime_rib` twice and then `resolve_anon_const`.
Delegates expression late resolution to `resolve_expr` with no special pattern context.
Captures diagnostic spans for a non-wild `let` binding, resolves the local binding, and then restores the previous diagnostic state. Calls `resolve_local`.

Performs late resolution for types, handling special cases such as elided reference lifetimes, type paths that may be bare trait objects, implicit `Self`, impl traits, trait objects, and bare function types while maintaining diagnostic context. Depending on the type form, it calls `resolve_elided_lifetime`, `with_generic_param_rib`, `visit_path`, `resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, `record_partial_res`, `visit_generic_params`, `with_lifetime_rib`, and `resolve_fn_signature`.

Introduces the `for<...>` generic/lifetime scope for a poly trait reference, resolves its path as a trait path, and then visits the trait reference itself. Calls `with_generic_param_rib`, `visit_generic_params`, `smart_resolve_path`, and `visit_trait_ref`.

Resolves foreign items with scope rules based on item kind: foreign type aliases and functions get generic/lifetime ribs, statics get a static rib, and unexpanded macro calls panic. Calls `with_generic_param_rib` for `TyAlias` and `Fn`, and `with_static_rib` for `Static`.

Resolves functions and closures by establishing function, label, and lifetime scopes; processing headers, generics, signatures, parameters, return types, async lifetime bookkeeping, and bodies; and preserving diagnostic context. Depending on function kind, it calls `visit_fn_header`, `visit_generics`, `with_lifetime_rib`, `resolve_fn_signature`, `record_lifetime_params_for_async`, `with_rib`, `with_label_rib`, `visit_block`, `visit_closure_binder`, `resolve_params`, `walk_fn_ret_ty`, and `visit_expr`.
Resolves generic parameters first, then resolves each where-clause predicate. Calls `visit_generic_params` and `visit_where_predicate`.

Resolves a generic argument while marking that generics are being processed; it disambiguates single-segment path type arguments that are actually const arguments, then resolves the appropriate substructure by kind. Calls `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, `with_constant_rib`, `smart_resolve_path`, `visit_ty`, `visit_path`, `visit_lifetime`, and `visit_anon_const`.

Resolves a where-clause predicate under anonymous-lifetime restrictions, creating a dedicated generic/lifetime binder for bound predicates and tracking diagnostic context. Calls `with_lifetime_rib`; for bound predicates it additionally calls `with_generic_param_rib`, `visit_generic_params`, `visit_ty`, and `visit_param_bound`.

Constructs a late-resolution visitor rooted at the crate module, initializing namespace ribs, lifetime state, diagnostic metadata, and function-body reporting defaults. Calls `Rib::new` to create the initial namespace ribs.

Performs lexical-scope resolution for an identifier with optional finalization and an optional ignored binding, using the current parent scope and ribs; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Resolves a path through the resolver using the current parent scope and ribs, optionally finalizing in a specific namespace; it does not call any other method from the Methods List.
Pushes a new namespace rib for scoped resolution, runs the supplied work, then pops the rib. Calls `Rib::new`.

If the node has an associated module, temporarily switches the parent module and introduces matching module ribs while executing the callback; otherwise it runs the callback directly. Calls `with_rib`.

Resolves a loop/block label by searching label ribs from innermost to outermost, validating reachability with `is_label_valid_from_rib`, and collecting typo suggestions via `suggestion_for_label_in_rib` before returning either the matching label or a resolution error.
Determines whether a found label is reachable from the current scope by scanning intervening label ribs and calling `is_label_barrier` on each rib kind to reject jumps across barriers.

Resolves an ADT item by setting the current self item with `with_current_self_item`, introducing generic parameter scopes with `with_generic_param_rib`, adding a `Self` type alias via `with_self_rib`, and then traversing the item with `walk_item`.

Checks `use` trees for imports that incorrectly refer to local variables or type parameters by querying lexical scope with `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` and `resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope`, reporting errors when needed, and recursively calling `future_proof_import` for nested imports.

Dispatches item resolution by item kind: it uses `with_generic_param_rib` for items with generics, delegates ADTs to `resolve_adt`, impls to `resolve_implementation`, traits to `resolve_trait_items` plus supporting scope setup, constants/statics to `with_static_rib`, `with_lifetime_rib`, `with_constant_rib`, `visit_ty`, and `visit_expr`, modules to `with_scope`, and imports to `future_proof_import`.

Pushes temporary ribs for generic type/value/lifetime parameters, rejects duplicate or shadowing parameters, records lifetime and type resolutions by calling `record_lifetime_param` and `record_partial_res`, runs the nested resolver action `f`, and then pops the ribs and finalizes lifetime-usage checks with `maybe_report_lifetime_uses`.
Executes a closure inside a freshly pushed label rib, creating the rib with `Rib::new` and removing it afterward.

Creates an item rib kind for the given generic-parameter context, then installs nested value-namespace and type-namespace ribs while executing the provided closure. This method explicitly calls `with_rib` twice: first for `ValueNS`, then inside that closure for `TypeNS`.

Executes constant-context resolution by installing constant-item ribs in the value and type namespaces with `with_rib`, adjusting generic permissiveness with `force_yes_if`, and wrapping the body in a matching label rib via `with_label_rib`.
Temporarily sets `current_self_type` in diagnostic metadata, runs the provided closure, and restores the previous value afterward.
Temporarily sets `current_self_item` in diagnostic metadata, runs the provided closure, and restores the previous value afterward.

Temporarily sets `diagnostic_metadata.current_trait_assoc_items` to the given trait items for the duration of a callback, then restores the previous value and returns the callback result. This method explicitly calls `replace` to swap the saved metadata and then calls the provided closure `f`.

Temporarily resolves and installs the current impl’s trait reference context: it calls `smart_resolve_path_fragment` to resolve the trait path, stores the resulting module/def-id, runs the provided closure with that optional trait id, and then restores the previous trait-ref state.
Pushes a temporary rib in the given namespace containing a direct binding for `Self`, runs the closure, and then pops the rib.
Convenience wrapper that installs a `Self` binding in the type namespace by calling `with_self_rib_ns`.

Resolves an `impl` block by creating generic scopes with `with_generic_param_rib`, setting temporary `Self` bindings with `with_self_rib`, enabling anonymous lifetime creation with `with_lifetime_rib`, resolving the optional trait context with `with_optional_trait_ref`, recording trait impl membership, visiting the trait ref/type/generics, setting the current self type with `with_current_self_type`, adding a value-namespace `SelfCtor` via `with_self_rib_ns`, and resolving each associated item with `resolve_impl_item`.

Verifies that an impl associated item matches an item in the currently referenced trait, reports mismatches or duplicates, and on success records the matched trait item resolution by calling `record_partial_res`.
Resolves a parameter list by first resolving parameter patterns inside an elided-lifetime rib with `with_lifetime_rib` and `resolve_pattern`, then visiting each parameter type with `visit_ty`.

Resolves a local binding by visiting its optional type, initializer expression, and optional `else` block with `visit_expr`/`visit_block`, then resolving the binding pattern with `resolve_pattern_top`.

Builds a binding map for a pattern by walking its subpatterns and recording identifier bindings that are true bindings (have a subpattern or resolve locally). For `PatKind::Or`, it calls `check_consistent_bindings` on the alternatives and extends the accumulated map with the returned per-arm maps.
Checks whether the already-recorded full resolution for a node id is a local binding by reading `partial_res_map` and testing for `Res::Local`.

Validates that every branch of an or-pattern binds the same names with the same binding modes, collecting missing and inconsistent bindings and reporting the corresponding diagnostics. It calls `binding_mode_map` to compute each branch’s bindings and `report_error` to emit errors.
Walks a pattern tree and runs top-level consistency checking for each nested or-pattern. It calls `check_consistent_bindings` on every `PatKind::Or` encountered.
Resolves a match arm inside a fresh value rib, resolving the arm pattern, then its guard, then its body. It calls `resolve_pattern_top` for the arm pattern and `visit_expr` for the guard and body.
Initializes the top-level binding context for pattern resolution and delegates to `resolve_pattern`.

Resolves a pattern in two phases: first walks it so names inside the pattern are resolved before new bindings are introduced, then performs binding resolution and finally checks nested or-pattern consistency. It calls `resolve_pattern_inner` and then `check_consistent_bindings_top`.

Performs the main pattern-binding resolution for direct subpatterns: identifier patterns are resolved as existing items/consts or turned into fresh locals, path-like patterns are path-resolved, and or-patterns get their own binding context stack handling. It calls `try_resolve_as_non_binding`, falls back to `fresh_binding`, and calls `smart_resolve_path` for tuple-struct, path, and struct patterns.

Creates or reuses a local pattern binding after checking for duplicate bindings in product patterns and legal reuse across or-pattern branches. It calls `report_error` for duplicate-binding diagnostics and `innermost_rib_bindings` to read or update the current value rib.
Returns the binding map of the innermost rib for the given namespace.

Attempts to interpret a pattern identifier as an already-existing non-binding name in value scope, handling the ambiguity between fresh bindings and constants/constructors/statics and producing shadowing-related diagnostics when needed. It calls `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` to look up the name and `report_error` when a resolved item must still be rejected as a pattern non-binding.
Convenience wrapper that resolves an AST path by converting it into segments and delegating to `smart_resolve_path_fragment`.

Resolves a path fragment in the namespace implied by its syntactic source, handling qpaths, deferred type-check resolution, candidate trait recording for calls, and rich error generation with suggestions. It calls `should_report_errs`, `smart_resolve_report_errors`, `report_missing_type_error`, `resolve_qpath_anywhere`, `traits_in_scope`, and `report_error` as part of resolution and diagnostics.
Checks whether `Self` is currently available in type namespace by calling `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` and rejecting `Res::Err`.
Checks whether `self` is currently available in value namespace by calling `maybe_resolve_ident_in_lexical_scope` and rejecting `Res::Err`.
Conditionally forwards a resolution error to the resolver only when `should_report_errs` allows diagnostics.
Returns whether late resolution should emit diagnostics in the current context, suppressing them for rustdoc function bodies.

Tries to resolve a possibly-qualified path across the primary namespace, then type and value namespaces, optionally accepting partially unresolved results for later type checking; if no qself is present, it also falls back to macro-path resolution. It calls `resolve_qpath` for each namespace candidate.

Resolves a qualified or unqualified path in a specific namespace, returning a partial resolution when later type checking must finish associated-item lookup or when fallback logic applies. For trait-qualified paths it calls `smart_resolve_path_fragment` on the trait prefix; otherwise it calls `resolve_path` for the whole path.

Executes a closure in a scope where an optional loop/block label has been registered, also tracking unused labels and diagnosing label shadowing. It calls `resolve_label` to detect prior labels and `with_label_rib` to introduce the new label scope.
Resolves a labeled block by wrapping block visitation in `with_resolved_label` and then calling `visit_block` on the block body.

Resolves a block by pushing the appropriate ribs for anonymous modules, normal block scope, and nested macro definitions, visiting each statement, then restoring the prior scope state. It calls `visit_stmt` on every statement while managing rib stacks.

Resolves an anonymous const expression inside a constant rib configured from repeat-expression status and whether the body may trivially reference const params. It calls `with_constant_rib`, which then runs `walk_anon_const`.

Resolves expressions by dispatching on expression kind, handling path and struct path resolution, labels, pattern-introducing forms, scoped control-flow constructs, field/method/call syntax, blocks, and const-generic/const-context details while preserving the right ribs and diagnostics context. It calls `record_candidate_traits_for_expr_if_necessary` first, and then uses helpers including `smart_resolve_path`, `resolve_label`, `report_error`, `resolve_pattern_top`, `resolve_labeled_block`, `with_resolved_label`, and `with_constant_rib` depending on the expression form.
Precomputes in-scope trait candidates for field access and method call expressions to support later method lookup diagnostics. It calls `traits_in_scope` and stores the result in `trait_map`.
Queries the resolver for traits visible in the current scope that match a given identifier and namespace.

Runs the late-resolution pipeline for an entire crate: first counts item lifetime parameters, then performs the full late name-resolution walk, and finally emits unused-label lints. It calls `walk_crate` twice, once with `LifetimeCountVisitor` and once with `LateResolutionVisitor::new(...)`.

Computes how many lifetime parameters are declared in the given `Generics` and records that count for the item identified by `id`. It calls `local_def_id` to map the AST `NodeId` to a local definition id, then uses `iter`, `filter`, and `count` over `generics.params` to count only lifetime generic parameters, and finally calls `insert` to store the result in `item_generics_num_lifetimes`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/item.rs:: Builds a HIR module by lowering module spans and collecting all contained item ids into arena storage. It explicitly calls `lower_item_ref` for each item.

Produces the HIR `ItemId` list referenced by an AST item, starting with the item's own id and expanding `use` items to include desugared imports. It explicitly calls `lower_item_id_use_tree` for `ItemKind::Use`.

Recursively flattens a `use` tree into all generated `hir::ItemId`s, descending into nested imports and adding extra ids for multi-namespace simple imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_item_id_use_tree`.
Constructs a full HIR item by lowering spans, owner id, attributes, item kind, and identifier, then allocating the result. It explicitly calls `lower_item_kind`.

Dispatches lowering for each AST `ItemKind` into the corresponding HIR form, including imports, const/statics, functions, modules, foreign modules, global asm, type aliases, enums, and structs. It explicitly calls `lower_use_tree`, `lower_const_item`, `lower_maybe_async_body`, `lower_fn_decl`, `lower_mod`, `lower_foreign_item_ref`, `lower_inline_asm`, `add_ty_alias_where_clause`, `lower_generics`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_variant` in the relevant match arms.
Lowers a const-like item's declared type and body expression, returning the HIR type plus body id. It explicitly calls `lower_const_body`.

Lowers a `use` tree into HIR import form, handling prefix concatenation, `self` imports, multi-namespace desugaring, nested imports, and creation of extra synthetic child owners for split imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_use_tree` when lowering nested imports.

Constructs a HIR foreign item by lowering its owner id, attributes, identifier, kind, and spans, with special handling for extern functions, statics, and type aliases. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Builds a lightweight `hir::ForeignItemRef` containing the lowered id, identifier, and span for a foreign item reference. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers one enum variant by lowering its id, attributes, field data, optional discriminant, identifier, and span. It explicitly calls `lower_variant_data`.

Lowers struct-, tuple-, or unit-style variant payloads, creating field definitions and aliasing constructor attributes to the parent where needed. It explicitly calls `lower_field_def` for each field.

Lowers a struct or tuple field definition, choosing path-specific or general type lowering, then lowering field id, attributes, spans, and identifier. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers a trait associated item into HIR, handling consts, required/provided methods, and type aliases with merged type-alias `where` clauses, plus final attributes and spans. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.
Builds a lightweight `hir::TraitItemRef` describing a trait associated item’s id, kind, defaultness, identifier, and span. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers an impl associated item into HIR, handling consts, methods, and type aliases, including merged type-alias `where` clauses and trait-vs-inherent method context. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.

Builds a lightweight `hir::ImplItemRef` containing the impl item’s id, identifier, span, defaultness, kind, and optional linked trait-item def id. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Converts AST defaultness into HIR defaultness, preserving the lowered `default` span when present and asserting finals always have a value. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Creates a HIR body from parameters and an expression, verifies it belongs to the current owner, stores it in the owner body table, and returns its `BodyId`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Runs a closure to lower a body while temporarily saving and restoring generator/task-context state, then records the resulting HIR body. It explicitly calls `record_body`.
Lowers a function parameter by lowering its id, attributes, pattern, and type/span information into `hir::Param`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers a function body by first lowering all input parameters and then lowering the body expression inside the generic body-lowering wrapper. It explicitly calls `lower_body` and `lower_param`.
Convenience wrapper for lowering a function body stored as an optional block expression. It explicitly calls `lower_fn_body` and `lower_block_expr_opt`.
Lowers an optional block into an expression, or produces an error expression when the block is missing. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers an optional const expression into a HIR body. It calls `lower_body` to create the body, and inside that closure calls `lower_expr_mut` for a present expression or `expr_err` to synthesize an error expression when the const body is missing.

Lowers a function body, dispatching between normal and async lowering. If the function is not async, it directly calls `lower_fn_body_block`; otherwise it calls `lower_body` and, within the async-body construction, lowers each parameter with `lower_param` before building the async closure body.

Lowers a method signature by translating the header, injecting implicit generics, and lowering the function declaration. It calls `lower_fn_header`, `add_implicit_generics`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST `FnHeader` into its HIR form by translating each header flag. It calls `lower_unsafety`, `lower_asyncness`, `lower_constness`, and `lower_extern`.
Resolves a parsed ABI string into a concrete `abi::Abi`. If lookup fails, it calls `error_on_invalid_abi` and falls back to `abi::Abi::Rust`.
Lowers an `Extern` specifier into the effective ABI. For explicit extern declarations, it calls `lower_abi`; otherwise it returns the default Rust or fallback ABI directly.
Emits the diagnostic for an invalid ABI literal, labeling the ABI span and listing valid ABI names. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Converts AST asyncness into HIR asyncness by mapping `Async::Yes` to `hir::IsAsync::Async` and `Async::No` to `hir::IsAsync::NotAsync`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Converts AST constness into HIR constness by mapping `Const::Yes` to `hir::Constness::Const` and `Const::No` to `hir::Constness::NotConst`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Converts AST unsafety into HIR unsafety by mapping `Unsafe::Yes` to `hir::Unsafety::Unsafe` and `Unsafe::No` to `hir::Unsafety::Normal`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Validates and lowers generic parameters plus the where-clause into an intermediate `GenericsCtor`, including diagnostics for misplaced `?Trait` bounds. It calls `lower_generic_params_mut`, `lower_where_clause`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers generics fully into `hir::Generics` by first building the intermediate representation and then materializing arena-backed storage. It calls `lower_generics_mut` and `into_generics`.
Lowers a where-clause by lowering each predicate and preserving the clause span. It calls `lower_where_predicate` for every predicate and `lower_span` for the overall where-clause span.

Lowers one AST where-predicate into its HIR variant. Depending on the predicate kind, it calls `lower_generic_params`, `lower_ty`, `lower_param_bound`, and `lower_span` for bound predicates; `lower_span`, `lower_lifetime`, and `lower_param_bounds` for region predicates; and `lower_node_id`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span` for equality predicates.

Converts the intermediate `GenericsCtor` into a final arena-allocated `hir::Generics`. It allocates the parameter list and reuses the stored where-clause and span, and does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Temporarily updates `is_in_trait_impl` based on whether an impl has a trait reference, runs the provided closure, and then restores the previous flag. Calls `is_some` on the optional trait ref and invokes the closure `f`.
Visitor override for attributes that intentionally does nothing, preventing attribute-contained expressions from being lowered. It does not call any other methods in the listed file.

Lowers an AST item into an HIR owner, then walks the item with the parent item's lifetime definitions in scope. It calls `with_hir_id_owner`, `without_in_scope_lifetime_defs`, `lower_item`, and `with_parent_item_lifetime_defs`; for impl items it also calls `with_trait_impl_ref` before delegating to `walk_item`, and otherwise directly calls `walk_item`.

Visits function-like items, handling foreign functions specially by lowering only their header and declaration while skipping any body; all other functions use the default walker. It calls `visit_fn_header` and `walk_fn_decl` for foreign functions, and `walk_fn` otherwise.

Creates an HIR owner for an associated item by lowering it according to whether it belongs to a trait or an impl, then walks the item contents. It calls `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_trait_item` for trait items or `lower_impl_item` for impl items, and then `walk_assoc_item`.
Lowers a foreign item into its own HIR owner and then walks the foreign item subtree. It calls `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_foreign_item`, and `walk_foreign_item`.

Temporarily extends the in-scope lifetime set with lifetime parameters taken from the parent item's lowered impl or trait generics, executes a closure, and then restores the previous scope length. It invokes the closure `f` but does not call any other methods from the listed file.

Runs a closure with `in_scope_lifetimes` temporarily cleared, asserting the expected item-level lifetime state before and after, then restores the old lifetime scope. It calls the closure `f` but no other methods from the listed file.
Clones an existing lowered `use` path into arena-allocated HIR, regenerating segment HIR ids while preserving identifiers, resolutions, and spans. It calls `next_id` to assign fresh ids.

Rebuilds an existing HIR visibility value, preserving simple visibility kinds and reconstructing restricted visibilities with fresh ids and rebuilt paths. It calls `rebuild_use_path`, `next_id`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers an AST visibility into HIR, translating public, crate, inherited, and restricted forms and assigning the restricted visibility its lowered path and HIR id. It calls `lower_node_id`, `lower_path`, and `lower_span`.

Constructs an `ImplTraitContext` in the disallowed state by returning `ImplTraitContext::Disallowed(ImplTraitPosition::Other)`; it does not call any other method in the provided Methods List.

Creates a reborrowed `ImplTraitContext` by pattern-matching the current variant and rebuilding the corresponding context with copied internal references or values. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Drives AST-to-HIR lowering for the whole crate: it builds the AST index, initializes owner slots, lowers each indexed owner node, computes the final HIR hash, and allocates the resulting `hir::Crate`. It explicitly calls `definitions` from the Methods List.

Drives top-level AST-to-HIR lowering for the crate: it verifies the crate def-id, walks crate items for pre-lowering collection, lowers the crate module and attributes under the crate HIR owner, computes the final HIR hash, and allocates the resulting `hir::Crate`. It explicitly calls `compute_hir_hash` from the Methods List.

Computes a stable fingerprint for the lowered HIR by collecting owner nodes, pairing them with definition path hashes, sorting them deterministically, and hashing the result; it does not call any other method in the provided Methods List.

Temporarily switches lowering state to a new HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure, packages the produced owner data, and restores the previous context. It calls `local_def_id` to resolve the owner, uses `std::mem::take`/`replace` to swap state, inserts the owner's zero local id with `insert`, invokes the closure `f(self)`, calls `make_owner_info` to build the final owner info, and finally records the owner in `children`.

Finalizes the accumulated data for one HIR owner into arena-allocated `OwnerInfo`. It takes the pending attrs, bodies, trait map, and inline-const flag, sorts bodies, builds a `SortedMap` with `from_presorted_elements`, calls `self.tcx.hash_owner_nodes(...)` to compute owner and attribute hashes, calls `index::index_hir` to build node and parenting indices, and allocates the resulting `hir::OwnerInfo` with `self.arena.alloc(...)`.

Computes stable hashes for one HIR owner both with and without bodies by creating a stable hashing context and hashing the owner under each mode. It explicitly calls `create_stable_hashing_context` from the Methods List.

Maps an AST `NodeId` to a HIR id for the current owner, reusing an existing mapping or allocating a new local id. On a vacant entry it inserts the new local id, advances the counter with `increment_by`, calls `opt_local_def_id` to record nested def ownership in `children`, and transfers any pending trait candidates from `resolver.trait_map.remove(...)` into the local `trait_map`.
Allocates the next fresh `HirId` for the current owner by reading the current counter, incrementing it with `increment_by`, and returning the resulting owner/local-id pair.

Converts a resolver `Res<NodeId>` into a HIR `Res` by calling `apply_id` to rewrite each referenced node id through the current `node_id_to_local_id` mapping, using `get` and `copied` for lookup. If rewriting fails for an enclosing-owner local, it returns `Res::Err` via `unwrap_or`.
Obtains the full resolver result for a node id by calling `self.resolver.get_partial_res(id)` and converting it with `map_or(..., |pr| pr.expect_full_res())`, defaulting to `Res::Err` if missing.
Extracts the fully resolved imported items for a `use` item from the resolver. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::get_import_res`.
Returns the session diagnostic handler used by lowering for error reporting. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.
Marks a span as desugared with the given reason and optional unstable allowances using the stable hashing context and current edition. It calls `with_stable_hashing_context` and `mark_with_reason`.
Temporarily switches `self.anonymous_lifetime_mode` for the duration of a closure, runs the closure, then restores the previous mode. It directly calls the passed closure `op`.
Adjusts a span for HIR lowering, attaching the current owner as the parent only when incremental compilation is enabled; otherwise returns the span unchanged.
Rebuilds an identifier with its span lowered for HIR. This method explicitly calls `lower_span`.

Temporarily enables anonymous-lifetime collection for a given parent def, records the starting length of `lifetimes_to_define`, runs a closure, then returns only the newly collected lifetime defs and restores the previous collection state. It directly calls the passed closure `f`.

Creates a lowered HIR lifetime generic parameter for an in-band, fresh, or error lifetime name by allocating a new node id, classifying the lifetime kind, creating a corresponding resolver definition, and preparing lowered ids/spans for the resulting `hir::GenericParam`; it does not call any other method in the provided Methods List.

Conditionally records a named lifetime for later in-band lifetime parameter synthesis only when collection is enabled, the feature is active, and the lifetime is neither already in scope nor already queued; it does not call any other method in the provided Methods List.

Allocates and records a fresh synthesized in-band lifetime name based on the current counts of queued and in-scope lifetimes, then returns that `ParamName`; it does not call any other method in the provided Methods List.
Temporarily extends `in_scope_lifetimes` with lifetime parameters from the given generic params, runs a closure, and then restores the previous scope length. It directly calls the passed closure `f`.

Lowers generics while collecting anonymous in-band lifetime defs and additional impl-trait defs, then appends synthesized lifetime parameters and returns the final HIR generics together with the closure result. It calls `collect_in_band_defs`, `with_anonymous_lifetime_mode`, `with_in_scope_lifetime_defs`, and `fresh_lifetime_to_generic_param`, and also directly calls the passed closure `f`.
Temporarily overrides the `is_in_dyn_type` flag while executing a closure, then restores the previous state.
Executes a closure in a fresh lowering scope by temporarily replacing current item, loop-condition, catch, and loop scope state, then restoring all previous values afterward.
Lowers and stores attributes for a HIR node, returning `None` for an empty attribute list. This method explicitly calls `lower_attr` for each attribute.
Lowers a single AST attribute by preserving its path/data structure, stripping tokens, lowering its arguments, and lowering its span. It calls `lower_attr_args` and `lower_span`.
Aliases already-lowered attributes from one HIR local id to another within the same owner when the target has stored attributes.

Lowers macro-argument token structures, preserving delimited arguments via token-stream lowering and handling key-value attributes by extracting a single lowered token. It explicitly calls `lower_token_stream` and the nested helper `unwrap_single_token` from the Methods List.

Recursively extracts one token from a token stream for key-value attribute lowering, reporting delayed bugs for malformed multi-token or unexpectedly delimited inputs and yielding a dummy token when empty. It explicitly calls `unwrap_single_token` recursively from the Methods List.

Flattens and lowers a token stream using the parse session, nonterminal-to-tokenstream mapping, and the selected token-synthesis policy. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Lowers an associated type constraint, including its generic arguments, equality/const/type terms, and bound forms, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized or return-type-notation syntax. This method explicitly calls `lower_angle_bracketed_parameter_data`, `emit_bad_parenthesized_trait_in_assoc_ty`, `dcx`, `lower_ty`, `lower_anon_const`, `lower_param_bounds`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident`.

Lowers a generic argument as a lifetime, type, inferred arg, or const arg, including the path-type-to-const disambiguation path used for trivial const arguments. It calls `lower_lifetime`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_span`, `get_partial_res`, `next_node_id`, `create_def`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_const_body`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST type and arena-allocates the resulting HIR type node. This method explicitly calls `lower_ty_direct`.

Lowers a path type, opportunistically converting a bare resolved trait path into a trait object when needed for fresh anonymous lifetimes; otherwise lowers it as a normal qpath type. It calls `get_partial_res`, `with_dyn_type_scope`, `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `elided_dyn_bound`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_qpath`, and `ty_path`.
Constructs a HIR type node with a fresh `HirId` and lowered span. It calls `next_id` and `lower_span`.
Constructs a tuple HIR type from pre-lowered element types. This method explicitly calls `ty`.

Performs the main AST-to-HIR lowering for type syntax, handling anonymous ADTs, pointers/references, functions, tuples, paths, and other type forms while creating nested owners when required. This method explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_field_def`, `lower_span`, `lower_ty`, `lower_mt`, `get_lifetime_res`, `next_node_id`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_safety`, `lower_extern`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_fn_params_to_names`.

Lowers an `impl Trait` opaque type by marking its desugared span, determining which lifetimes must be captured or duplicated based on origin and precise captures, and delegating final opaque construction. It calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, and `lower_param_bounds`.

Builds an HIR owner node for a synthesized opaque type item by wrapping the provided opaque type in `hir::Item` metadata and allocating it in the arena. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Extracts lowered parameter names from a function declaration, using the lowered identifier for simple identifier patterns and an empty placeholder ident otherwise. It calls `lower_ident` and `lower_span`.

Lowers a function signature by dropping the AST varargs sentinel, lowering each input type under the appropriate `impl Trait` policy, and lowering the return type either normally or through coroutine-specific opaque-return handling. It calls `lower_ty_direct`, `local_def_id`, `lower_coroutine_fn_ret_ty`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers an `async fn` return type into the desugared opaque `impl Future` HIR return, collecting captured extra lifetimes, building the async opaque type, and wrapping it as `FnRetTy::Return`. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::take_extra_lifetime_params` and `impl<'a, 'hir> LoweringContext<'a, 'hir>::lower_async_fn_output_type_to_future_bound`.

Builds the `Future<Output = T>` bound used in async-fn desugaring by lowering the explicit return type or synthesizing `()` for default returns, then packaging it as a `Future` lang-item trait bound. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.

Lowers a single generic bound into HIR, converting trait bounds and outlives bounds through the appropriate lowerers. It calls `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `lower_trait_bound_modifiers`, and `lower_lifetime`.
Lowers an AST lifetime by first calling `lower_ident` on the lifetime name, then calling `new_named_lifetime` with the original node id to build the HIR lifetime.
Resolves a lifetime through `get_lifetime_res`, defaulting to `LifetimeRes::Error` on failure, then calls `new_named_lifetime_with_res` to produce the lowered HIR lifetime.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic parameter by mapping the input slice and calling `lower_generic_param` for every element.
Lowers a slice of generic parameters into arena-allocated HIR output by calling `lower_generic_params_mut` and collecting the iterator with `alloc_from_iter`.

Lowers one generic parameter by calling `lower_generic_param_kind` to compute its HIR name and kind, then assigns ids/spans/attributes using `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST trait reference by calling `lower_qpath`, requiring the result to be a resolved trait path, and then creating the HIR trait ref with `lower_node_id` for the reference id.
Lowers a poly trait reference by calling `lower_lifetime_binder` for bound generic params, `lower_trait_ref` for the trait itself, and `lower_span` for the resulting HIR span.
Lowers a mutable type by calling `lower_ty` on the inner type and preserving the mutability flag.
Lowers a slice of generic bounds into arena-allocated HIR bounds by calling `lower_param_bounds_mut` and collecting with `alloc_from_iter`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic bound by mapping the slice and calling `lower_param_bound` on each element.
Lowers an AST block expression by calling `lower_block` and then wrapping the result with `expr_block`.

Lowers an array length const expression. For `_`, it may create an inferred length using `lower_node_id` and `lower_span` when the feature is enabled; otherwise it reports instability and falls back to calling `lower_anon_const`. All non-underscore lengths are lowered by calling `lower_anon_const`.

Lowers an anonymous const inside fresh scopes by calling `with_new_scopes`; within that closure it uses `local_def_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_const_body`, and `lower_span`, then arena-allocates the resulting HIR anon const.
Maps the AST `UnsafeSource` enum directly to the corresponding HIR `UnsafeSource` variant without calling other methods from the list.

Converts an AST trait-bound modifier into its HIR form, gating negative bounds on the corresponding feature flag and choosing placeholder HIR variants for invalid parsed combinations so lowering can continue. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.
Builds a HIR statement by assigning a fresh id with `next_id` and lowering the statement span with `lower_span`.
Builds an expression statement by arena-allocating the expression and then calling `stmt` with `hir::StmtKind::Expr`.

Builds a `let` statement from a pre-lowered pattern and optional initializer. It assigns a fresh id with `next_id`, lowers the span with `lower_span`, stores statement attributes when present, and finally calls `stmt` after arena-allocating the `hir::LetStmt`.
Wraps a lowered expression in a block by calling `block_all` with no statements and the expression as the tail expression.
Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR block from statements and an optional tail expression, assigning a fresh block id with `next_id` and lowering the span with `lower_span`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Continue` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowContinue`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Break` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowBreak`.
Builds an `Option::Some` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the contained pattern and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionSome`.
Builds an `Option::None` pattern by directly calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionNone` and no fields.
Creates a single tuple-struct-style pattern field for index 0, assigning a fresh field id with `next_id` and lowering the field spans with `lower_span`.
Builds a struct pattern referring to a lang item variant by lowering the span with `lower_span` to form a `QPath::LangItem`, then calling `pat` with `hir::PatKind::Struct`.
Builds an identifier pattern with the default binding mode by calling `pat_ident_binding_mode` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE`.

Convenience wrapper that creates a mutable identifier pattern using no explicit binding mode. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE` and returns the resulting pattern and `HirId`.

Builds an identifier pattern with an explicit binding mode, then allocates it in the HIR arena. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` to construct the `hir::Pat` and `self.arena.alloc` to return a shared HIR reference together with its `HirId`.

Constructs an owned `hir::Pat` for an identifier binding with the given binding mode. It calls `next_id` to assign a fresh `HirId`, `lower_ident` to lower the identifier, and `lower_span` to lower the source span.

Allocates a general HIR pattern with default binding modes enabled. It calls `next_id` to create the pattern’s `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span, and `self.arena.alloc` to store the pattern in the arena.
Constructs an owned HIR pattern like `pat`, but with `default_binding_modes` disabled. It calls `next_id` for a fresh `HirId` and `lower_span` for the lowered span.

Builds a `hir::Ty` from a qualified path, rewriting resolved trait or trait-alias paths into `hir::TyKind::TraitObject`. In that trait-object case it calls `lower_span` to build the `PolyTraitRef`, `next_id` to give the outer `Ty` a new id, and `elided_dyn_bound` to supply the implicit `dyn` lifetime bound; it also calls `lower_span` again for the final type span.

Lowers an elided lifetime that appears in a reference type according to the current anonymous-lifetime mode: it may synthesize a fresh parameter, emit an error lifetime, or pass through as an implicit lifetime. It calls `collect_fresh_anonymous_lifetime`, `lower_span`, `new_error_lifetime`, and `new_implicit_lifetime`.
Creates an error lifetime, allocating a fresh node id when one is not supplied. It calls `new_named_lifetime`.
Produces an iterator yielding `count` elided path lifetimes for the given span. It calls `elided_path_lifetime` for each element.

Lowers an elided lifetime appearing in path generic arguments, either creating an error lifetime in forbidden contexts or an implicit lifetime in normal/reporting modes. It calls `new_named_lifetime` and `new_implicit_lifetime`.

Creates and arena-allocates an implicit object lifetime bound used for elided `dyn` lifetimes. It calls `next_id` to assign a `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span used in the lifetime identifier, and `self.arena.alloc` to return the allocated lifetime.
Constructs a HIR implicit lifetime with a fresh HIR id and lowered span. It calls `lower_span`.
Checks whether the generic-argument builder contains no args, no bindings, and no parenthesized form. It does not call any other methods from the provided list.

Finalizes the builder into an arena-allocated `hir::GenericArgs`. It calls `this.arena.alloc_from_iter` to allocate the argument list, `this.lower_span` to lower the stored span, and `this.arena.alloc` to allocate the completed `hir::GenericArgs`.

Walks `impl Trait` bounds to collect lifetime names and spans that should be captured by the generated opaque type, excluding lifetimes newly bound inside the bounds and optionally filtering by an allowed set. It relies on the nested visitor methods `visit_generic_args`, `visit_ty`, `visit_poly_trait_ref`, `visit_generic_param`, and `visit_lifetime` during traversal.
Visits generic arguments while temporarily disabling elided-lifetime collection for parenthesized `Fn(...)`-style arguments. It calls `intravisit::walk_generic_args`.
Visits a type while suppressing elided-lifetime collection inside bare function types and restoring the bound-lifetime stack afterward. It calls `intravisit::walk_ty`.
Visits a poly trait reference and restores the bound-lifetime stack to its previous height after traversing any `for<'a>` binders. It calls `intravisit::walk_poly_trait_ref`.
Records lifetime generic parameters as newly bound before visiting their contents so later lifetime uses inside the binder are not treated as captures. It calls `intravisit::walk_generic_param`.

Processes each encountered lifetime, normalizing implicit/elided cases, ignoring non-capturable lifetimes, and collecting only lifetimes that are not currently bound, not already recorded, and allowed by the optional filter set. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_resolve/src/def_collector: Creates a new local definition under the current `parent_def` by forwarding to `resolver.create_def`, using the current expansion id and a parentless span. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Temporarily replaces `self.parent_def`, runs the provided closure in that parent context, and then restores the original parent. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Temporarily switches `self.impl_trait_context`, executes the provided closure, and restores the previous impl-trait context afterward. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Collects a struct or tuple field definition. For placeholder fields it records the inferred field index and calls `visit_macro_invoc`; for normal fields it computes the field name, calls `create_def` to allocate the field def, and then calls `with_parent` to walk the field body under that new definition.
Records the current definition and impl-trait context as the parent information for a placeholder macro invocation expansion. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Collects definitions for items by choosing the appropriate `DefPathData` from the item kind. For macro-call items it calls `visit_macro_invoc`; for definable items it calls `create_def`, then calls `with_parent` to walk nested contents, and for items that introduce universal impl-trait scope it also calls `with_impl_trait` while traversing.

Collects nested definitions inside functions. For async functions it calls `create_def` for the synthesized return `impl Trait` and async closure defs, then calls `with_parent` to visit the return type and body in the desugared parent context; otherwise it performs the normal function walk. It does not call other methods from the Methods List besides `create_def` and `with_parent`.
Creates `Misc` defs for a `use` tree and any extra ids produced by a simple import, then walks nested use-tree structure. It calls `create_def`.

Collects a foreign item definition. If the foreign item is a macro call it calls `visit_macro_invoc`; otherwise it calls `create_def` for the item and then calls `with_parent` to walk its nested structure.

Collects an enum variant definition and its constructor when present. Placeholder variants call `visit_macro_invoc`; normal variants call `create_def` for the variant, then call `with_parent`, inside which they may call `create_def` again for a tuple/unit constructor before walking the variant body.
Traverses variant fields in order and calls `collect_field` for each field with its enumerated index so tuple-field numbering stays stable.

Collects a generic parameter definition according to whether it is a lifetime, type, or const parameter. Placeholder parameters call `visit_macro_invoc`; otherwise it calls `create_def`, then calls `with_impl_trait` to walk the parameter in a universal impl-trait context.

Collects an associated item definition using value or type namespace as appropriate. Associated macro calls invoke `visit_macro_invoc`; other associated items call `create_def` and then call `with_parent` to walk nested contents under the new definition.
Handles patterns by calling `visit_macro_invoc` for pattern macro calls and otherwise delegating to the normal pattern walk.
Creates a definition for an anonymous const and then calls `with_parent` to walk the const body beneath that new anon-const definition. It calls `create_def` and `with_parent`.

Collects defs introduced by expressions. Macro-call expressions call `visit_macro_invoc`; closure and async expressions call `create_def` for the generated closure defs, then call `with_parent` so nested traversal occurs under the appropriate closure parent; all other expressions are walked under the current parent.

Handles types, especially `impl Trait`. Type macro calls invoke `visit_macro_invoc`; `impl Trait` creates an opaque type def—either directly through `create_def` in existential context or through `resolver.create_def` in universal context—and then calls `with_parent` to walk the type under that opaque def; other types are walked normally.
Handles statements by calling `visit_macro_invoc` for statement macro calls and otherwise performing the normal statement walk.
Handles match arms by calling `visit_macro_invoc` for placeholder arms and otherwise walking the arm normally.
Handles expression fields by calling `visit_macro_invoc` for placeholder fields and otherwise walking the field expression normally.
Handles pattern fields by calling `visit_macro_invoc` for placeholder fields and otherwise walking the pattern field normally.
Handles function parameters. Placeholder parameters call `visit_macro_invoc`; other parameters call `with_impl_trait` so parameter traversal happens in a universal impl-trait context.
Delegates field-definition handling to `collect_field` with no precomputed index.
Handles the crate root by calling `visit_macro_invoc` when the crate is a placeholder expansion root, and otherwise walking the crate normally.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::co: Traverses all item-like nodes in the given module and runs `CollectItemTypesVisitor` over them to trigger collection/type-signature queries. It calls `tcx.hir()` and then `deep_visit_item_likes_in_module`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::pr: Registers this module’s collection-related query providers, wiring functions such as `collect_mod_item_types`, `generics_of`, `predicates_of`, `fn_sig`, `trait_def`, `adt_def`, `impl_trait_ref`, `impl_polarity`, `generator_kind`, `codegen_fn_attrs`, and others into `Providers`. It does not meaningfully call other methods from the list; it assigns them as query hooks.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Visits a HIR type, records the span when the type is an inferred placeholder `_`, and then continues recursive traversal. It calls `intravisit::walk_ty`.
Visits a generic argument, records placeholder inference arguments, recursively walks inferred args, and forwards type arguments to the type visitor. It calls `intravisit::walk_inf` and `visit_ty`.
Visits an array length, records the span for inferred array lengths, and then continues recursive traversal. It calls `intravisit::walk_array_len`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::re: Checks selected item kinds (structs, enums, unions, traits, impls, aliases, opaque types) for forbidden `_` placeholders in their signatures. It creates a `HirPlaceholderCollector`, calls `visit_item` to gather placeholder spans, and then calls `placeholder_type_error` to report them.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Supplies the HIR map used for nested visitor traversal. It calls `self.tcx.hir()`.

Collects interface information for each item, rejects placeholder types in supported item signatures, and then recursively visits nested HIR. It calls `convert_item`, `reject_placeholder_type_signatures_in_item`, and `intravisit::walk_item`.

Forces collection queries needed by generic parameters, including defaulted type parameters and const parameters/defaults, before recursing into the generics. It calls `self.tcx.hir()`, `self.tcx.ensure().type_of`, `self.tcx.ensure().const_param_default`, and `intravisit::walk_generics`.

Ensures closure expressions have their generic information collected, while intentionally avoiding `type_of` for closures to keep typeck failures visible, then continues traversal. It calls `self.tcx.hir()`, `self.tcx.ensure().generics_of`, and `intravisit::walk_expr`.
Collects interface information for a trait item and then recursively visits its contents. It calls `convert_trait_item` and `intravisit::walk_trait_item`.
Collects interface information for an impl item and then recursively visits its contents. It calls `convert_impl_item` and `intravisit::walk_impl_item`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ba: Creates the base E0121 diagnostic for placeholder `_` appearing in item-signature types, pluralizes the item kind, sorts spans, and labels each offending span. It does not call other methods from the provided list.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Constructs a new `ItemCtxt` from a type context and item `DefId`. It does not call other methods from the list.
Converts a HIR type into a compiler `Ty` using the `AstConv` machinery. It calls `AstConv::ast_ty_to_ty`.
Returns the HIR id corresponding to the current item definition. It calls `self.tcx.hir()`, `expect_local`, and `local_def_id_to_hir_id`.
Fetches the current HIR node for this item context. It calls `hir_id`, `self.tcx.hir()`, and `get`.
Returns the underlying type context stored in the item context. It does not call other methods from the list.
Returns the current item `DefId` wrapped in `Some` for `AstConv`. It does not call other methods from the list.
Queries the predicates/bounds associated with a referenced type parameter in the current item context. It calls `self.tcx.at(span).type_param_predicates` and `expect_local`.
Disables lifetime inference in item signatures by always returning `None`. It does not call other methods from the list.
Disables type inference in item signatures by returning `false`. It does not call other methods from the list.
Handles forbidden type placeholders during AST-to-type conversion by producing an error type. It calls `tcx` and then `ty_error_with_message`.

Handles forbidden const placeholders by first replacing erased regions with `'static` in the const’s type and then creating an error const. It calls `self.tcx.fold_regions`, `tcx`, and `const_error_with_message`.

Builds a projected associated type from a trait reference when no late-bound regions remain; otherwise it emits E0212 and constructs context-sensitive lifetime suggestions based on the enclosing HIR item. In the successful path it calls `AstConv::create_substs_for_associated_item`, `tcx`, and `mk_projection`. In the error path it calls `node`, `hir_id`, `self.tcx.hir()`, and emits a diagnostic before returning an error type.
Returns the type unchanged, intentionally avoiding normalization for item signatures to prevent extra dependencies. It does not call other methods from the list.
No-op hook for tainting by errors in this item-signature conversion context. It does not call other methods from the list.
No-op hook for recording types discovered while converting item signatures. It does not call other methods from the list.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ge: Generates a fresh lifetime name not already used by the trait reference or the item's declared lifetime parameters. It calls `collect_referenced_late_bound_regions` to gather existing late-bound lifetime names, combines them with lifetime params from `generics`, and finds the first unused `'a`/`'aa`-style candidate.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ty: Builds the full predicate set for a type parameter by combining inherited bounds from the parent item with bounds written on the current item's generics/where-clause. It calls `ItemCtxt::get_type_parameter_bounds` for parent-derived bounds and `ItemCtxt::type_parameter_bounds_in_generics` to extract bounds from the current HIR generics, also adding the implicit `Self: Trait` predicate for trait `Self` parameters when needed.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Collects predicates from `where`-clause bound predicates in a `hir::Generics` that apply to a target type or `Self`. It calls `to_ty` to lower non-parameter bounded types, `bound_defines_assoc_item` to optionally restrict bounds to those defining a requested associated item, and `predicates_from_bound` to convert each matching HIR bound into `ty::Predicate` values.

Checks whether a trait bound may define a particular associated item name. For trait bounds, it calls `trait_def_id` to resolve the referenced trait and then `trait_may_define_assoc_type` to test whether that trait could define the requested associated type; non-trait bounds return `false`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::co: Forces collection-related queries for a top-level HIR item according to its kind, without type-checking bodies. Depending on the item, it calls queries like `generics_of`, `type_of`, `predicates_of`, `fn_sig`, `impl_trait_ref`, `trait_def`, `super_predicates_of`, and `explicit_item_bounds`; it also calls `convert_enum_variant_types` for enums, `convert_variant_ctor` for struct/union constructors, and `placeholder_type_error` after visiting items with `HirPlaceholderCollector` when placeholder types in signatures must be rejected.

Forces the interface queries for a trait item and validates illegal placeholder types in trait associated items. Forces the interface queries for an impl item and reports placeholder associated type signatures. Forces collection queries for an enum/struct variant constructor item. It calls `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of` on the constructor's local def-id.

Computes enum variant discriminants, reports discriminant overflow, and forces collection of each variant field and constructor type. Builds a `ty::VariantDef` from HIR variant data, checking for duplicate field names and recording field metadata and non-exhaustiveness. It gathers field def-ids and visibilities, emits duplicate-field errors when needed, and constructs the final variant definition with `ty::VariantDef::new`.

method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::su: Returns the complete supertrait predicate set for a trait by delegating directly to `super_predicates_that_define_assoc_type` with no associated-item filter.

Computes a trait or trait-alias superpredicate set, optionally restricted to bounds that may define a given associated item. For local traits, it builds colon-supertrait bounds with `AstConv::compute_bounds_that_match_assoc_type` or `AstConv::compute_bounds`, gathers where-clause `Self` bounds with `ItemCtxt::type_parameter_bounds_in_generics`, and for transitive implied predicates queries `super_predicates_of` on referenced supertraits when appropriate.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::tr: Builds the compiler's `ty::TraitDef` for a local trait or trait alias, collecting flags such as auto-trait status, unsafety, marker/specialization attributes, and validating trait-level attributes like `rustc_paren_sugar` and `rustc_must_implement_one_of`. It inspects associated items and attributes to assemble the final trait definition metadata.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ha: Helper for late-bound-region detection on a specific function signature. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Visits a type while searching for late-bound regions, tracking binder depth across bare function types. It calls `intravisit::walk_ty` to recurse, wrapping bare function types with `shift_in`/`shift_out` so nested binders are handled correctly.

Visits a poly trait reference while searching for late-bound regions, adjusting binder depth for the trait-ref's bound lifetimes. It calls `intravisit::walk_poly_trait_ref` between `shift_in` and `shift_out`.

Classifies each encountered lifetime while searching for illegal late-bound regions. It calls `named_region` to resolve the lifetime and records the span when the region is free, improperly late-bound at the current depth, or unresolved.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ha: Helper for late-bound-region detection on a specific function signature. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Visits generic parameters to detect whether the target anonymous const appears inside a const parameter's type. For const params, it temporarily marks `in_param_ty` and calls `visit_ty` on the parameter type.

Detects when the tracked anonymous const is reached while traversing a const-parameter type. If it is not the targeted const in parameter-type context, it continues recursion by calling `intravisit::walk_anon_const`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ge: Computes the `ty::Generics` for a local definition by determining its generic parent, handling special cases such as impl/trait items, variant ctors, fields, anonymous consts, opaque types, and closures, and extracting the in-scope parameters. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ar: Returns whether a list of generic arguments contains an inferable placeholder that can participate in a user-facing suggestion. It calls `is_suggestable_infer_ty` for type generic arguments and treats explicit `Infer` arguments as suggestable.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::is: Recursively checks whether a HIR type contains `_`-style inference that is suitable for a diagnostic suggestion. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ge: Extracts a function return type only when it is an inferable/suggestable placeholder. It calls `is_suggestable_infer_ty` on `FnRetTy::Return` and returns that type if suggestion logic should handle it.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::fn: Computes the polymorphic function signature for local functions, methods, foreign functions, constructors, variants, and closures. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Computes the implemented trait reference for an impl item, if any. It calls `type_of` to obtain the impl self type and `AstConv::instantiate_mono_trait_ref` to lower the HIR trait path into a monomorphic `ty::TraitRef`.

Determines whether an impl is positive, negative, or reservation, and emits errors for invalid uses of `#[rustc_reservation_impl]`. It inspects the impl HIR and attribute state, using `span_err` for disallowed negative or inherent reservation impls.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ea: Iterates the lifetime parameters from a `hir::Generics` that are early-bound rather than late-bound. It filters `generics.params` by calling `is_late_bound` and keeping only lifetime params for which that returns `false`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::pr: Builds the predicates defined directly on `def_id` by starting from `explicit_predicates_of` and, when present, appending `inferred_outlives_of` predicates to the result.

method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ga: Collects the explicit predicates written for a local item by inspecting its HIR node, generics, and item kind, setting up trait/default-impl context as needed, and assembling the resulting `GenericPredicates` from the item’s declared bounds and related inherited information.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::co: Traverses a local item to gather `ConstEvaluatable` predicates from anonymous consts. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::im: Handles an anonymous const during traversal by converting it to a const value and, if it is unevaluated, inserting a `ConstEvaluatable` predicate for it into the collector.

method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::co: Computes the polymorphic signature of a foreign function declaration by calling `AstConv::ty_of_fn`, choosing intrinsic unsafety when needed via `intrinsic_operation_unsafety`, and then checking the resulting input/output types for gated SIMD FFI usage.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::is: Returns whether a local `def_id` corresponds to a HIR `ForeignItem`, and bugs out if the `DefId` is non-local.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::st: Returns the mutability of a local `static` or foreign `static` item identified by `def_id`, yielding `Some(mutbl)` for those cases, `None` for other local nodes, and panicking for non-local `DefId`s. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ge: Returns the generator kind for a local closure expression by looking up the closure body and querying its `generator_kind`; returns `None` for non-closure locals and bugs on non-local `DefId`s.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::fr: Parses a `#[target_feature]` attribute, validates each requested feature against the target and enabled feature gates, emits diagnostics for malformed or unsupported entries, and appends accepted features to `target_features`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::li: Maps a textual LLVM linkage name to the corresponding `Linkage` enum value, emitting a fatal error using `def_span` for invalid names.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::co: Collects and validates code generation-related attributes for an item, building a `CodegenFnAttrs` result. method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::sh: Determines whether an impl method should inherit `#[track_caller]` from its trait declaration by looking up the associated trait item and calling `codegen_fn_attrs` on that trait item to test for the `TRACK_CALLER` flag.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_typeck/src/collect.rs::ch: Validates and extracts the integer value from a `#[link_ordinal]` attribute, ensuring the attribute shape is correct and that the ordinal fits in `u16`, otherwise emitting diagnostics.
Checks that `#[link_name]` and `#[link_ordinal]` are not both present in the same `CodegenFnAttrs`, emitting an error when both are set.
Rejects `#[target_feature]` on safe trait impl methods by inspecting the enclosing impl item and trait context and emitting an error when the annotated method is not `unsafe`.

Converts an AST unary operator directly into the corresponding HIR unary operator without calling other methods from the list.
Converts an AST binary operator into a HIR `BinOp`, preserving its span by calling `lower_span`.

Rewrites a call using legacy const-generic argument positions into a normal generic call by splitting const and value arguments, attaching synthesized generic args to the path, then calling `lower_expr` for the callee and `lower_exprs` for the remaining runtime arguments.
Lowers an `if` expression by calling `lower_cond` for the condition, `lower_block_expr` for the then-block, and `lower_expr` for the optional else-expression.

Wraps a non-`let` condition expression in a temporary-dropping HIR node for conditional desugaring, while leaving `hir::ExprKind::Let` unchanged. It explicitly calls `mark_span_with_reason` to mark the desugared span and `expr_drop_temps` to build the drop-temporaries wrapper.
Local recursive helper that checks whether an expression tree contains any `let` expression by recursively inspecting binary subexpressions and calling itself on both operands.

Builds a call to a lang-item constructor around an already-lowered expression; it calls `expr_lang_item_path` to create the callee and `expr_call` to invoke it.

Lowers a match arm, including its pattern, optional guard, attributes, body, and span. It calls `lower_pat`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_expr`, and `lower_attrs`, and for `if let` guards it calls `lower_pat` and `lower_expr` again to build the lowered `hir::Let`.

Constructs the desugared HIR for an async block/closure body by creating the generator closure, resume parameter, and wrapper call. It calls `lower_ty`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `lower_body`, `lower_node_id`, `mark_span_with_reason`, and `expr_lang_item_path`.

Lowers a closure expression by lowering its binder, body, generator metadata, generic params, and function declaration, then assembling a HIR closure node. It calls `lower_closure_binder`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_fn_body`, `lower_expr_mut`, `generator_movability_for_fn`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.

Determines whether a lowered closure body should be treated as a generator and validates movability and parameter-count constraints, emitting errors when needed; it does not call other methods from the list.

Lowers an async closure by building an outer closure whose body produces an async generator expression, while checking unsupported binder and capture combinations. It calls `lower_closure_binder`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_fn_body`, `make_async_expr`, `lower_expr_mut`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.

Local recursive helper that decides whether an assignment lhs is a normal assignable place or needs destructuring desugaring; it calls `extract_tuple_struct_path` for call expressions and calls itself recursively through parenthesized expressions.

Convenience wrapper that lowers a destructuring-assignment lhs into an arena-allocated HIR pattern by calling `destructure_assign_mut`.

Lowers a sequence-shaped destructuring lhs, collecting element patterns and at most one `..` rest position. It calls `destructure_assign_mut` for non-rest elements and `ban_extra_rest_pat` when multiple rest patterns are found.

Lowers non-closed range syntax into a struct expression for the appropriate range lang item, selecting the lang item shape, emitting an error for inclusive ranges without an end, and lowering present endpoints. It calls `lower_expr`, `lower_span`, and `expr_field`.
Lowers an optional loop label by lowering its identifier; it calls `lower_ident`.
Lowers a `break`/`continue` destination by resolving either an explicit label or the current loop scope into a HIR target id and lowered label. It calls `lower_node_id` and `lower_label`.

Lowers a break/continue destination, rejecting unlabeled control flow inside a while-condition by producing `UnlabeledCfInWhileCondition`; otherwise it calls `lower_loop_destination` on the optional mapped label.

Builds an unlabeled `break` expression targeting the current loop by calling `lower_loop_destination` and then `expr`.
Allocates and returns a `break` expression by calling `expr_break` and storing the result in the arena.
